# NexStack Logics

> NexStack Logics is a full-stack technology partner. One team builds, secures and scales a business's entire digital presence: web and app development, e-commerce on Shopify, WordPress, Wix and Squarespace, cybersecurity, Meta ads, cloud and DevOps, and AI automation. Tagline: "Empower Today. Own Tomorrow." Status: launching soon, with a waitlist open at https://www.nexstacklogics.com.

## Services

- Web & App Development: custom websites, web applications and mobile apps, built end to end.
- Cybersecurity & Auditing: security audits, hardening and ongoing protection for sites, apps and cloud.
- Shopify & E-Commerce: online store setup, custom Shopify themes and apps, and store growth.
- WordPress, Wix & Squarespace: website builds, redesigns and management on these platforms.
- Meta Ads & Growth: Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns and performance marketing.
- Cloud & DevOps: hosting, deployment pipelines, scaling and infrastructure management.
- AI & Automation: AI integrations and workflow automation for businesses.

## Key facts

- Name: NexStack Logics (also written NexStack)
- Website: https://www.nexstacklogics.com
- What makes it different: every tech service a business needs, from one team, instead of hiring separate agencies.
- Status: launching soon. Visitors can join the waitlist on the homepage to be notified at launch.
